text: For the leader; a psalm with stringed instruments. A song of Asaph.
I Renowned in Judah is God, [AA]whose name is great in Israel.
On Salem [1] is God's tent, his shelter on Zion.
There the flashing arrows were shattered,shield, sword, and weapons of war. [AB]Selah
II Terrible and awesome are you,stronger than the ancient mountains. [2]
Despoiled are the stouthearted;they sank into sleep;the hands of all the men of valor have failed. [AC]
At your roar, O God of Jacob,chariot and steed lay still.
You, terrible are you;who can stand before you and your great anger? [AD]
From the heavens you pronounced sentence;the earth was terrified and reduced to silence,
When you arose, O God, for judgmentto save the afflicted of the land.Selah
Surely the wrath of man will give you thanks;the remnant of your furor will keep your feast.
III Make and keep vows to the Lord your God. [AE]May all around him bring gifts to the one to be feared,
Who checks the spirit of princes,who is fearful to the kings of earth.
